race.description: Sandy Creek Pub Double Smoked Ham Grand National Hcp (58)
race.comment: HEART 'N' POWER (4) ran another good race last time when third over 1350m at Ipswich, beaten 1.75 lengths. Saves her best form for this distance range and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Drawn nicely and is one of the main chances. FIERY LASS (1) was safely held when ninth last time out over 1350m at Ipswich, beaten 6 lengths after being in the firing line on the corner. That followed a win at Sunshine Coast at the previous outing. This doesn't look as hard so she can make amends. SHES A BELLE (9) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1350m at Ipswich, beaten 4.5 lengths into seventh. Beautifully placed here and is sure to take a ton of beating. STREET DAZZLER (2) was safely held when sixth last time out over 1210m at Toowoomba, beaten 7 lengths, after a win at this circuit at the previous outing. Gets 2kg off from the low draw so anticipating a better run this time.
